snippet.title: Pokémon Scarlet and Pokémon Violet | The Shiny Treasure of Ruin ✨
snippet.description:
A new Tera Raid Battle event series is happening that will feature Shiny Wo-Chien, Shiny Chien-Pao, Shiny Ting-Lu, and Shiny Chi-Yu!

Everyone will have to work together to obtain these treasures! ✨
